item.title: Thursday 10 AM Update, Nov 19
item.description:
The Thursday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 19, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow morning; the White House reportedly benches Homeland Security Secretary Mullin from TV, and a Russian national is indicted for stalking Palantir workers; Putin rules out ceasefire talks after strikes on the Crimean Bridge, and the World Court finds Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya; stocks jump as Anthropic's record IPO opens on the Nasdaq, Walmart beats, and jobless claims tick up; TSMC halts advanced chip orders for Chinese designers; banks tell customers they're on their own with AI agents; a JPMorgan vendor breach and Microsoft's new Edge Lockdown Mode; your X feed; Dolly Parton's Imagination Library bill and weekend events; and Singapore schoolboys thank construction workers with fried chicken. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday Morning, Nov 19
item.description:

item.title: Wednesday 4 PM Update, Nov 18
item.description:
The Wednesday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 18, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow afternoon; Florida's driver license and vehicle systems go down as experts point to a flood of rushed software patches behind the recent outages; President Trump will meet Vladimir Putin one-on-one in China tomorrow, and the US and Venezuela sign a deal to restore military ties; stocks close mixed as UnitedHealth sinks and Fed minutes point to more rate hikes, with Anthropic's IPO price due tonight; Nvidia promises early raises at its first all-hands without Jensen Huang; Google opens up Genie 4 interactive worlds; a critical decade-old NGINX flaw and a breach touching Irish credit unions; your X feed; a fatal crash in Amherst and the Flying Santa at the Aviation Museum in Londonderry; and students racing to save a wildflower that grows in only one county. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
